expiryPage.title: Expiry Tracker
expiryPage.batchesDesc: Oldest-expiring stock first (FIFO) — remaining quantity is estimated from sales/damage/expiry recorded against each product since the batch arrived. Discount suggestions get steeper the closer a batch gets to its expiry date; refrigerated and frozen items use a much tighter timeline than shelf-stable goods, since they can go from fine to a write-off in days. Use these as a starting point, not a fixed rule.

help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Quick answers for everyday tasks.
help.searchPlaceholder: What do you want to do?

firstSteps.a: Follow the checklist on the Dashboard: set up the store, add products, put stock on the shelf, invite staff, then make a test sale.

importProducts.q: How do I add many products at once?
importProducts.a: Products → Import. Download the template or use your own spreadsheet (CSV or Excel). We check every row before anything is saved.

receiveStock.q: How do I record a delivery?
receiveStock.a: Stock Arrival → choose the product and quantity. If the product comes in cartons, enter the number of cartons and we work out the units. Add batch and expiry dates for perishables.

moveToShelf.q: Why can't I sell an item I just received?
moveToShelf.a: New stock goes to the backroom. Use Stock Movements → Transfer to shelf to make it available at the till.

sell.q: How do I make a sale?
sell.a: Checkout → Start New Order. Scan barcodes with a scanner or the camera, tap a best seller, or search. Then choose how the customer pays and confirm.

shift.a: A cashier's time on the till. Start a shift with the cash in the drawer, and end it by counting the cash. The Z-report shows any over or short.

discount.q: How do I give a discount?
discount.a: In an open order, tap Discount and enter a % or an amount. Cashiers can give up to the store's limit; bigger discounts need a manager's email and password.

splitPay.q: Customer wants to pay part cash, part card?
splitPay.a: Tap Split payment, add each payment method and amount. Cash can be more than what's due — we show the change.

refund.q: How do I refund or take back an item?
refund.a: Sales & Refunds → find the receipt → View → Refund / return items. Choose quantities; untick Restock for damaged goods. Only managers and admins can refund.

receipts.q: How do I reprint or send a receipt?
receipts.a: Sales & Refunds → View. Print, save as PDF, send on WhatsApp, or share the link. Every receipt also has a QR code to a digital copy.

thermal.q: Can I print to a receipt printer?
thermal.a: Yes. On a receipt, choose the printer connection (USB, Serial, Bluetooth, or Wi-Fi on the shop computer), then Print to receipt printer. Any printer installed on the device, including Wi-Fi and AirPrint printers, also works with the normal Print button.

labels.q: How do I print price labels and barcodes?
labels.a: Labels & Barcodes → set how many copies of each product, choose a label size, Print. Products without a barcode can get an in-store barcode in one click.

credit.q: How do I sell on credit (pay later)?
credit.a: Add the customer under Customers, then choose Credit at checkout. Their balance updates automatically; record payments and send WhatsApp reminders from the Customers page.

loyalty.a: Turn them on in Store Settings. Pick the customer as a Loyalty member at checkout so they earn points; use Use points to spend them as a discount.

tax.q: How do I set up VAT or sales tax?
tax.a: Store Settings → Tax. Enter the rate and whether your shelf prices already include tax. Receipts and reports then show the tax.

staff.q: How do I add a cashier?
staff.a: Invites → create an invite with their role and share the code by WhatsApp, SMS or email. Admins can set or reset a staff password from Users.

offline.q: What happens when the internet goes down?
offline.a: Keep selling. Sales and stock changes are saved on the device and sent automatically when the connection returns. The top bar shows how many are waiting.

endOfDay.q: Where do I see today's takings?
endOfDay.a: End of Day shows sales, payment methods, refunds, top items and busiest hours for any date, in your store's time zone.

insights.q: Which products make me the most money?
insights.a: Insights → Profit & margin, ABC analysis and Dead stock show what earns, what's slow, and what is tying up cash.

reorder.a: Replenishment suggests quantities from your sales. Create a purchase order and send it to the supplier as a PDF or on WhatsApp.

security.q: How do I keep my account safe?
security.a: My Account → turn on Two-factor sign-in with an authenticator app. If a phone is lost, use Sign out all other devices and change your password.

export.q: How do I download my data?
export.a: Admins can export store data (CSV/JSON) from Export. Anyone can download their personal data from My Account.

support.a: Support → New ticket. Our team replies in the app.

settlements.q: How do commissions and settlements work?
settlements.a: Online storefront payments go straight to your bank with the platform's commission taken at source. For pay-on-delivery orders you collect the money, so the commission is added to your balance and cleared automatically from your next online payments — or you can pay it any time from Settlements.

paymentsCard.intro: Let shoppers pay online on your storefront. Payments are processed by Paystack and paid straight into YOUR bank account — SAFE Stores never holds your customers' money. Paystack's fee is taken from each payment.

paymentsCard.currencyUnsupported: Online payments aren't available for {{currency}} yet. Pay on delivery still works.
paymentsCard.privacy: We pass the account number to Paystack and keep only its last 4 digits.
paymentsCard.linked: Bank account linked — online payments are on
paymentsCard.acceptOnline: Accept online payments on my storefront
paymentsCard.transferHelp: Shoppers can pay straight into your bank account. They see these details after ordering; you confirm the order when the money arrives.
paymentsCard.transferNotePh: e.g. Send proof of payment on WhatsApp 0803…
paymentsCard.acceptTransfer: Accept bank transfer on my storefront
paymentsCard.noConnection: Could not reach the server. Check your internet and try again.

settlementsPage.title: Settlements
settlementsPage.subtitle: Your balance with SAFE Stores for orders that come through your online storefront.
settlementsPage.payPrompt: Your balance is {{amount}}. Pay it any time — or it's cleared automatically from your next online orders.

settlementsPage.notConfirmed: We couldn't confirm the payment yet. If you were charged, it will update shortly.

settlementsPage.howOnline: Online payments go straight from Paystack to your bank account. Our {{pct}}% commission is taken out automatically before it reaches you.
settlementsPage.howCash: Pay-on-delivery orders: you collect the full amount from the customer, so the {{pct}}% commission is added to your balance when you mark the order fulfilled.
settlementsPage.howNetting: Your balance is cleared automatically from your next online payments — up to {{pct}}% of each one — so you rarely need to pay separately.
settlementsPage.howLimit: If your balance goes over {{limit}}, pay-on-delivery pauses until it's settled.
settlementsPage.howPos: In-store sales at your till are never charged commission.

businessType.label: Type of business
businessType.d_general: Items sold one by one. All the standard tools.
businessType.d_butchery: Sell by weight (kg), fresh-meat shelf life and waste log, and break-downs from carcass to cuts.
businessType.d_abattoir: Live animals broken down into carcass, cuts, offal and hides with yield; sell by weight; fresh shelf life and waste log.
businessType.d_fresh_produce: Sell by weight (kg), short shelf life and an end-of-day waste log.
businessType.d_ice_cream: Recipes that use up ingredients to make your products, sell by cup or litre, frozen shelf life and waste log.
businessType.d_bakery: Recipes that use up flour, sugar and so on to make bread and cakes, short shelf life and waste log.
businessType.d_tailor: Job orders with customer measurements, deposits, fittings and collection; fabric sold and used by the yard.
businessType.d_laundry: Job orders with deposit, status (washing, ready, collected) and collection payment.
businessType.d_mechanic: Check in customers' vehicles with plate number, mileage and condition; QR tag on the key; parts from stock, labour, notes and collection.
businessType.d_tech_repair: Check in phones, laptops and other devices with serial/IMEI and condition; QR tag on the device; diagnosis, parts, notes and collection.
businessType.d_engineering: Check in generators, pumps and machines with their details and fault; QR tag on the item; parts, labour, notes and collection.
businessType.d_restaurant: Dishes made from your ingredients (recipes take them off stock), sold by the plate; fresh stock and an end-of-day waste log.
businessType.d_building_materials: Cement, rods, blocks, roofing, doors, windows, tiles, plumbing, sanitary ware, electrical and paint: sell by the bag, piece, length or tonne, with reorder alerts for fast movers.

onsite.title: In-store only
onsite.intro: When this is on, cashiers and other shop-floor staff can only sell, receive stock, move stock or record refunds from inside the shop. They can still look things up from anywhere. If someone tries from outside, it is blocked and you get an alert.

onsite.off: Off: staff can work from anywhere
onsite.setupFirst: Save the shop's internet connection or set the shop's location below before switching this on.
onsite.networksHelp: Do this in the shop, on the shop Wi-Fi. Anyone using the app on this connection counts as in the shop. Add each connection the shop uses (for example the Wi-Fi and a backup router).

onsite.gpsHelp: Stand inside the shop and tap the button. Staff whose phone is off the shop Wi-Fi are asked for their location instead, and must be within the distance below.

onsite.whoIsExempt: You (the owner), managers, the online market manager and booked auditors can work from anywhere. Shop computers on the shop network are always allowed. Sales made with no internet are checked by where they were made when they sync.
